lines.say: slowed liver enzymes CYP2D6, 2C9 and 3A4 in healthy men, which can raise drug levels
blood sugar falls modestly in type 2 diabetes (many trials poorly reported)
modest drops in weight and BMI (18 studies, many at high risk of bias)
nausea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation and diarrhea
can cause or worsen newborn jaundice, risking brain-damaging kernicterus

ask: Could berberine interact with any of my medicines, especially ones broken down by the liver?
